states.meaning: The step ran and produced valid geometry.
The step ran, but something needs attention, such as a fillet radius that was reduced or text that runs past the face.
The step did not run; the model continues without it. The failure code says why and how to fix it.
The step was not run because it refers to something a failed or suppressed step would have created.
The step is turned off. It stays in the script and can be turned back on.
The step is saved but has not been built yet.

actions.title: Body
actions.summary: Add a new labelled part from a box, rounded box, cylinder, cone or sphere.
actions.description: Use for the blocks, bases and plinths a deal toy starts from. The step name becomes the part label, and the part gets named sides (top, bottom, left, right, front, back) for later steps. Do not use it to cut material: use extrude with operation cut, hole, or combine.

size.description: Box size along X, Y and Z

radius.description: Edge radius of a rounded box

diameter.description: Diameter of a cylinder or sphere, or the bottom diameter of a cone

top_diameter.description: Top diameter of a cone; 0 makes a point

height.description: Height of a cylinder or cone

at.description: Where the centre of the body's bottom sits, in model coordinates

on.description: Optional face or plane the body stands on; its bottom is placed on it, centred at the projection of at

failures.explanation: A face this step refers to no longer exists, often after an earlier step or a parameter changed.
failures.fix: Pick the face again, or refer to a name an earlier step created.

failures.explanation: A face or edge query matched two candidates equally well, so the step refused to guess.
failures.fix: Move the reference point closer to the intended face, or pick it by a created name.

failures.explanation: No construction plane has that name.
failures.fix: Use the name of an earlier plane step.

failures.explanation: The selected face is curved, but this action needs a flat face or a construction plane.
failures.fix: Pick a flat face or a plane.

failures.explanation: The operation produced geometry that is not a valid solid.
failures.fix: Try a smaller size or a different face; check the step's inputs against the part's size.

failures.explanation: An input is missing, has the wrong type or is out of range.
failures.fix: Read the action's inputs with actions_describe and correct the value.

failures.explanation: Another step or part already uses this name.
failures.fix: Give the step a unique name.

failures.explanation: The step raised an unexpected error.
failures.fix: Read the message; if it persists, simplify the inputs or use a custom step.

actions.title: Construction plane
actions.summary: Add a named construction plane: offset from a face, angled about an edge, midway between faces, or through 3 points.
actions.description: Use to place features where no face exists, such as text floating on a mid-plane or a cut through the middle of a part. A plane adds no material. Later steps refer to it with m.datum(name).

from.description: The face or plane to offset or rotate from

distance.description: Offset along the normal of from

about.description: The straight edge to rotate about, for method angle

angle.description: Rotation about the edge, for method angle

between.description: The two parallel faces for method midplane

actions.title: Extrude
actions.summary: Extrude a rectangle, rounded rectangle, circle, slot or polygon from a face to add, cut or make a part.
actions.description: Use for pockets, bosses, slots and recesses with a simple outline. Use hole for round holes with counterbores or countersinks, text for lettering, and combine to cut one existing part from another. Negative distances go into the part.

on.description: The flat face or construction plane to work on

width.description: Profile width along the face's horizontal direction

length.description: Profile length along the face's vertical direction

radius.description: Corner radius of a rounded rectangle

diameter.description: Diameter of a circle, or of the circle around a polygon

at.description: A point in model coordinates, projected onto the face; defaults to the face's centre

rotation.description: Rotation of the profile about the face normal

extent.description: How far to go: a distance, a distance split both ways, through the whole part, or up to a face

distance.description: Distance along the face normal; negative goes into the part

up_to.description: The face to stop at when extent is up_to

taper.description: Draft angle of the side walls; positive narrows away from the face

operation.description: Make a new part named after the step, add to the target, or cut from it

target.description: The part to join to or cut from; defaults to the part that owns the face

creates.end: The end face opposite the starting face
creates.sides: The side walls of the extrusion

actions.title: Hole
actions.summary: Cut a simple, counterbored or countersunk round hole into a face, to a depth, through all or up to a face.
actions.description: Use for mounting and screw holes. The hole is drilled perpendicular to the face at the point at. For non-round cavities use extrude with operation cut; to make a cavity shaped like another part, use combine.

on.description: The flat face the hole is drilled into

at.description: A point in model coordinates, projected onto the face; defaults to the face's centre

up_to.description: The face to stop at when extent is up_to

creates.wall: The cylindrical wall of the hole
creates.floor: The flat bottom of a blind hole

actions.description: Use to soften the edges of blocks and bases. A radius that is too large for an edge is reduced to the largest that builds, and the step reports a warning. For a flat bevel use chamfer.

actions.title: Combine
actions.summary: Join, cut or intersect one part with another; cut and keep the tool to make an embed cavity.
actions.description: Use to merge parts, to cut one part's shape out of another, or to keep only their overlap. Cutting with keep_tool makes the cavity an embedded object sits in, such as a coin in an acrylic block. The tool part is removed unless keep_tool is true.

tool.description: The part used to change it

operation.description: Join adds the tool, cut removes it, intersect keeps only the overlap

actions.description: Use to place parts relative to each other, such as setting a figure on its base. Align moves the part so its face lies against the target face, facing it, at the offset. Moving changes no shapes.

actions.title: Custom step
actions.summary: Run a Python function from this script as a step, for anything the other actions do not cover.
actions.description: Use only when no action fits. The function is defined at top level in the script, outside the steps section, as def name(m, **inputs), and may return a dict of created names to faces. Every other keyword argument is passed to it. If you write the same function twice, offer to save it for reuse.

fn.description: The top-level function to run, by name
